subject: [PATCH 48/60] mm/madvise: restrict reclaim advice to reclaim-capable memory

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The patch series introduces a new function folio_allows_reclaim() to restrict reclaim advice to common memory. The change affects MADV_COLD, MADV_PAGEOUT, and MADV_FREE operations.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series restricts the reclaim advice to only common memory, adding a new function folio_allows_reclaim() that checks if the node permits reclaim. The change affects MADV_COLD, MADV_PAGEOUT, and MADV_FREE operations.
